name: Serving Love: The Food Truck Duo
source:
Ever wondered what it was like working in a food truck that sells baked goods? Well, then this game probably sucks, as the food truck business isn't booming for the main characters! 

Will you be able to help them out? Perhaps even romance one of the two? Find out in this short lovely visual novel!

[From [url=https://tanime.itch.io/serving-love-the-food-truck-duo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
有没有想过在销售烘焙食品的餐车里工作是什么感觉？好吧，那么这款游戏可能会很糟糕，因为对于主角来说，食品卡车生意并不繁荣！

你能帮助他们吗？也许甚至会爱上两者之一？在这部可爱的短篇视觉小说中找到答案吧！

[来自[url=https://tanime.itch.io/serving-love-the-food-truck-duo]itch.io[/url]]
